direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh at 1366x768, overflow hidden; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only, equal-width non-wrapping targets with aria-current and arrow-key movement; independent reserved zones for callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; scene at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, a cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions preserved: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels, one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness, checking provider identity, separate from investigation as a distinct evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; pending proposal deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and approved plan coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory scene within its reserved zone to at least 70% of main and reduce empty station-card height so flow, glow and depth read cinematically at 1366x768.
Raise right-zone body copy to 16px/24 and keep evidence values tabular; preserve both logo placements unchanged.
Link Certificate 120 and Receiving 80 bars bidirectionally to their evidence cards with a 2px emerald focus ring.
Separate connection readiness, labelled as checking provider identity, from the distinct investigation evidence task with individual headings, status lines and controls.
Compress the connection panel so the investigation action remains visible without squeezing the scene below 70%.
Add living flow only along the held route and a static silver state for idle machines, with reduced-motion fallback.
Make each Select this path control at least 36px, keyboard reachable, and visibly linked to the matching option card in the scene.
Increase tradeoff metrics hierarchy while keeping one verb-led instruction and one status sentence.
On selection, trace the chosen feasible route once for 240ms, then leave a static emerald glow.
Keep the typed consent form opened by selection, with the exact phrase, character count and disabled Accept state grouped as one labelled form.
Give the consent input a 2px emerald focus ring and announce match state through aria-live polite.
Dim unselected paths in silver without removing their readable hours and cost.
Make proposed tasks visually untracked until approval: dashed silver borders, PROPOSED label and no progress semantics beyond sequence.
Strengthen depth between stations and job cards with raised silver edges and restrained emerald glow on the first ready task.
Ensure Approve proposal remains the sole primary in the 56px action bar.
Preserve the strong preview: CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red, and no route through it.
Animate material flow rerouting around the offline cell once on apply, then settle static; disable that motion under reduced-motion preference.
Enlarge the 24h to 0h preview metric and bind it bidirectionally to the station node.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 fully legible over hatching: raise label contrast, retain cross marker and OFFLINE text inside station bounds.
Separate provider-identity readiness from the investigation task exactly as on the earlier investigation step for consistency.
Show only two feasible paths in emerald and mark Split as constrained in silver pattern and text.
Keep the constrained Split path non-selectable with reason text adjacent, not colour alone.
Make the revised typed consent form the clear focus after selection, with status centre in the action bar reading prior acceptance invalidated.
Add one cinematic route trace to the substitute path on real state change, then static glow.
Preserve coexistence: blocked prior tasks and approved revised plan remain distinct while replacement tasks stay proposed and untracked until approval.
Visually separate the blocked prior group with silver hatching and text from the proposed replacements in dashed emerald outline.
Refit side-zone task detail to 16px body so all three task selectors and approval status fit at 1366x768.
Clarify the three proof stages as sequential gates with Ready, Locked and Locked text plus pattern, not glow alone.
Enlarge the 21 events headline and verified-chain metrics for judge-distance impact while keeping the scene zone dominant.
Keep Verify ledger as sole primary and announce its result through aria-live polite.
Refit the full-shop cascade to balanced department zones: enlarge every machine glyph, reduce the oversized Assembly area, and keep all departments visible without disproportionate empty space.
Apply consistent stopped treatment at every scale: silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text large enough to read at 1920x1080.
Add living material flow and feasible-route glow only on real running paths, with depth on machine bodies and reduced-motion static equivalents.
Enlarge or refit the embedded cascade preview so machines and OFFLINE states are legible in the judge-facing pitch rather than a thin distant strip.
Tighten the opening story to the five-step sequence already shown, keep the second official logo placement prominent and unchanged, and move the live demo action nearer the headline.
Increase contrast and spacing in the partner table and closing sections while retaining only black, emerald and brushed silver.
